title: Run History — Last 5 runs summary on home screen
description: Store last 5 runs in save data (runHistory array). Each entry: { score, omen, relics, shards, bits, timestamp }. On home screen, add scrollable 'LAST RUNS' mini panel below main stats showing run thumbnails with omen icon, relic count, and score. Helps players remember builds and creates a sense of run narrative over time.
